items.headline: Markets (wk of Oct 19): risk-off rotation — S&P 500 ~7,624 (-0.5% wk), Nasdaq -0.7% (QQQ ~$703 after a ~2.9% midweek drop) as investors fled AI-spending exposure into staples/energy/utilities; 10-yr Treasury broke below 5% (~4.95% Thu, biggest 1-day drop since Mar 2023) before bouncing to ~5.0%; Fed expected to hold 3.75-4.0% Oct 28

Tenstorrent (Jim Keller) closed a $1.5B Series E at a $6.2B post-money valuation (Oct 19), led by Trace Capital and Innovation X with ARK, Fidelity, T. Rowe Price, Morgan Stanley, Sandisk, Tether; scales Galaxy AI servers + open RISC-V silicon and open-weight models — the open/licensable alternative to Nvidia

Anthropic opened a research preview of Claude Duet (Oct 21), a standalone proactive-agent app on Claude Opus 5.5: sends a morning brief across connected apps, keeps working in its own cloud VM with a browser, checks in before sensitive actions; answer to OpenAI 'Dots' and Meta 'Muse'; Pro/Max in the US

a16z is renaming its crypto arm 'a16z Frontier' (Oct 22) and broadening its mandate from blockchain into AI, autonomous machines, and networks connecting people and AI agents; AI now ~64% of a16z's activity; topped the 2026 Strebulaev-Jackson AI venture ranking

Flapping Airplanes, a year-old AI research lab, raised a $1B Series A at a $6B valuation (Oct 21) — nine months after a $180M seed — led by Index, Lux, Sequoia, GV, Kleiner Perkins; the week's clearest froth marker as public AI multiples compress
Otter.ai closed a $320M growth round (Oct 20, General Catalyst) for its meeting-transcription + AI-assistant platform — applied-AI productivity now a growth-stage bet, not a feature

Tesla started Optimus production in Fremont (Oct 21) — first production-quality units — but pushed customer deliveries to ~Q2 2027 (hands/durability/AI 'still need work'); Q3 profit fell 43%; unsupervised FSD for customer cars slid to mid-2027

Cycling: 2027 transfer market and UCI reshuffle — Tao Geoghegan Hart to EF Education-EasyPost, Victoire Berteau to Canyon-SRAM; UCI's Oct 15 registration deadline left TotalEnergies, Kern Pharma, Flanders-Baloise, Euskaltel off the provisional 2027 list pending paperwork
Learn (video): 'Vercel's CEO Just Unveiled The Greatest AI Coding Workflow Ever' (Oct 19) — breaks Guillermo Rauch's AI coding workflow into 7 repeatable tips, recreated in Claude Code
Learn (video): 'Build a Social Media AI Agent Team Using Claude Code & Next.js' (Oct 16) — full build-along course on standing up a coordinated team of agents with handoffs; teaching artifact for FAU

Markets (wk of Oct 5): volatile week ended green — S&P 500 ~7,811 (+0.6% Fri), Nasdaq ~27,366, both up on the week into earnings season after a midweek ~1.4% Nasdaq drop on an OpenAI revenue warning and AI-bubble calls; 10-yr Treasury ~5.25% (30-yr ~5.61%), Fed-hold odds ~81% for October

AI-bubble debate goes mainstream: Ray Dalio warns AI is a 'classic bubble' near bursting, Mike Novogratz calls it 'the biggest bubble of our lifetime' but says pile in; an OpenAI revenue warning dragged the Nasdaq ~1.4%; Anthropic reportedly pushed its IPO Oct→Nov and OpenAI ruled out a 2026 listing

Manus raised >$500M (Oct 8), its first round since regulators forced Meta to abandon an acquisition (Tencent among backers); same week a16z led TypeSafe AI (model hit 1T tokens in 3 days) and backed Preference Model

Anthropic courts builders: Claude for Startups expanded to a free year of Claude Team (5 seats) + $1,000 API credits (Oct 6), shipped Claude Haiku 5.5 (Oct 7, ~75% cheaper), and launched Claude Marketplace with 2,000+ plugins; Docs/Slides/Design out of beta on all plans

Reflection debuted Beam (Oct 5), a frontier open-weight model claiming to match leading Chinese open models on reasoning at far lower compute cost; part of a release-heavy week (Mistral Large 4, Gemini Nano Banana 2.1, Z.ai GLM 5.3, Claude Haiku 5.5)
Instinct raised a reported $1B Series C for a personal AI assistant for everyday tasks — the clearest consumer 'do-it-for-me' agent wager of the cycle, challenging OpenAI/Google assistant ambitions

YC Fall 2026 batch skews deep tech with 'far more grounded' valuations (Demo Day Dec 2), headlined by Atomarine (nuclear-powered data centers floating at sea) — hard-atoms, capital-intensive bets back at the earliest stage

Physical-AI startup Atoms led the week's funding table as US venture dollars fell to ~$3.97B (-57% WoW) with 8 of 10 biggest rounds AI-native, incl. Valar Atomics $660M Series B (nuclear for AI) and Armadin $255.5M Series B at $2.5B (a16z)

a16z reportedly raising toward a $10B vehicle to double down on AI, on top of its $1.1B 'Machine Age' fund for AI's physical buildout; ~40% of new capital already pointed at AI — setting pricing gravity for smaller checks

Cycling: Il Lombardia (Oct 10, 239km Bergamo→Como) runs WITHOUT Tadej Pogacar for the first time since 2020 (out injured after 5 straight wins), opening the final Monument for Evenepoel, del Toro, Seixas, McNulty
Learn (video): 'Multi-Agent Workflows in Claude Code: Skills, Subagents & Handoffs (2026)' — a build-alongside walkthrough of orchestrating multiple agents and subagent handoffs with Skills

Learn (research): 2026 systematic review of ChatGPT in higher ed (Li, Cui & Serra) — AI boosts creative output but critical-thinking gains depend on scaffolding (verification, rubrics, AI-literacy); unstructured use erodes judgment; FAU teaching material
